messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed best score handling. [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts) now keeps the lower move count for each size, preserving the existing best on ties or worse games. [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx) now shows `none` when that size has no saved record.

`git diff --check` passed. I didn’t run tests.
